t:
Oh, heaven, joy, and bliss! A riddle

to solve! Then I will know what to do.

The goals will be set, and the direction clear.

Now that it's done, will you vanish? Disappear?

Dissolve into thin air? Am I right?
r483998.n: All right, here's how it goes. "Wherever moon shall meet the shiny sun, the fate will…

t:
Oh, now I understand. It is a trial.

A test of moral values, so to speak.

The destiny I have been waiting for.

For forty years, from then till now,

I've been expecting my fate

to find me. Oh, this requires deeds, not words.

I am prepared, my friend.
r483999.n: I'm telling you, all I need is the note! I've never seen you in my life!

t: Good news! You may now return to your default class without using the Core Impression! Just purchase the Memory Stamp from me, and you can save your default class to return to it at any convenient time.
r484697.n: Good news! You may now return to your default class without using the…

t: Every class trainer can sell you one. Use it to save your current class as default. Voila, now you can return to your default class anytime.

I was too arrogant to ignore my aches... I hit my head on a branch and twisted two ankles! Thank the spirits it happened near the camp. The locals helped me and gave me food and water. They also told me a lot of stories. It almost feels like home.

I didn't leave home just to settle down somewhere else, even in a nice place like this. I looked at the sky and felt that my heart was full. The open road is calling my name again. Where should I head? I remembered the story of Kyros and Aellona. Kyros, the poor fellow, defeated our chief and earned the tribe's respect... After Aellona died, he went mad and messed up everything. Such a sad story, but also beautiful. I could write a song about it.

I decided to visit Aellona's grave. I'll leave in the morning.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484721.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
Oh spirits, I have the strangest feeling. It's like guilt for being alive when Aellona is dead. Enough of being sad, though. I should leave a note in a safe place, away from prying eyes...

I'm asking myself why I'm doing this. Do I want to leave a trail? Do I secretly hope that someone might follow my tracks? Do I expect someone to find me? My sister, a secret admirer, or just someone simply wandering around the world?

Since I started making notes, I should continue. Now I'm wondering where it will take me!

It cheered me up. Where will I go next? I think I'll visit Polis. It isn't far from here. I heard it was a lovely place full of people. Maybe I can find a friend there.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484733.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
The demon hands you the note in silence.

Demons are amazing. I didn't expect them to be this beautiful. They use images to communicate. Images appear directly in your head. Isn't it wonderful? It's weird how many people might consider them evil or dark creatures. Of course, they can scare you, and they can't take a joke, but they are so, so beautiful!

People despise rats as well, but have rats ever hurt anyone? They're living beings who want their share of food and water! Hardly any rat ever crawled inside a house with malicious intent!

Some demons never heard of centaurs, so I left a note to the most curious of them. He gave me something in exchange...

This is a lovely place. I'll sleep it off here, and then I'll head to Triquetrum. Aoidos mentioned "energies" there. I need to see them.
r484742.n: Can you give it to me?

t:
I didn't expect Polis to be such an amazing place. Aoidos managed to build so many things here. What a gifted nation! Just like us.

I came across a weird vagabond who was looking for something, mumbling nonsense. I tried to run away, but he just wouldn't leave me alone! One thing led to another, and here we are, relaxing after exploring this city's every nook and cranny. To understand how much fun we had, just imagine how hard it is for a CENTAUR to climb onto a roof. I'm not sure I can repeat that!

My friend loves secrecy and conspiracies! Poor fellow, he just can't see past these mysteries. I should remember to leave him a note about my future plans. It should make him happy.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484744.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
Just think about it. No two-legged creature can imagine how hard it is to sneak quietly on four muscular legs.

I got carried away and walked through the whole the camp! I can't brag about it to anyone, but it's something I can write down in my notes!

Familiar places look different at night. You get to notice things you never noticed before. It makes you understand things you couldn't until now. But enough of "philosophizing", as Aoidos used to say.

My sister was asleep as I grabbed the toy. I think she sensed my presence but never woke up. I don't know how. She might have sighed in a special way. I grew up with her, so I can feel her with my heart.

I know she will forgive me. She won't think I escaped.

There's only one place left to visit. It's the Site of Power. They say that the swords are always clashing there. I'll go to the champions' camp and get myself drunk to leave these lands without a second thought.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484756.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
I think I know what Aoidos meant by "energies". We'd say this place was "blessed by the spirits". They might have over-blessed it a bit. Everything here seems ordinary and miraculous at the same time.

The most interesting places are never talked about. You only get to know them by chance: overhear a conversation or spot a turn in the road... I'm getting more and more confident that I made the right decision. You can't just sit around peacefully when there's a big world outside with so much to see!

I hope some other strange adventurer who finds my notes and follows my tracks will never regret their decision!

I discovered that I left my favorite toy behind. It's not that important, but it holds so many good memories. I'll drop by our camp tonight. Just need to make sure not to run into my sister or friends.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484758.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
All right, the swords here aren't always clashing. I didn't see a single battle while I was here. I guess I was incredibly lucky.

Boy, did we get drunk! I couldn't imagine so many people can ride my back all at once! An idea of giving people rides never occurred to me in the first place.

I received a mug with my name on it - somebody carved it with a knife. I was called "a great man and an average horse". They also invited me to stop by whenever I'm around. I will stop by on my way back, perhaps.

They say alcohol won't solve your problems. It sure won't, but a good party can chase away the gloom. It's important to maintain the balance... It's very important.

I'm going to the Dionic Archipelago. I've heard a lot of wonderful things about it. I'll see you on the docks, my imaginable follower.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484768.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
The docks don't seem extraordinary after you've seen Polis. Just barrels and crates... The flight was something to remember, though. I've never... flown? or sailed? Never traveled much. Anyway, a sensation's worth a thousand words.

I found a way to entertain myself, though. I assumed an air of importance and started walking around, opening boxes and barrels, examining their contents. People regarded me with suspicion, but no one dared to approach me. I looked very confident and somewhat menacing. I took nothing, though. I was just curious. Only one thing looked intereting: a sphere made of a semi-transparent gemstone, with fine dust whirling and glowing inside...

It's getting dark. The dockers told me there was a village not too far away. I'll spend the night and hit the road in the morning.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484772.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
It turns out, I'm fond of villages, no matter who lives there (unless it's someone who wants to rip out your guts). They all look alike in a way. Whatever happens in the world, they live their own lives, look after their households, be it centaurs or humans...

I'm getting more and more romantic. I wonder if the travels induced this in me, or if it's an adventurer's disease, common for all wanderers. I neither can nor want to figure it out! I think I'll just go with the flow.

I've been dreaming about lying alone on a pasture, far away from home, without knowing what lies ahead, simply admiring the stars. It's time to make the dream come true. Let me find the nearest pasture and head right there.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484776.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
So, I've been watching the sunset. I'm writing this note while the sun is still up, so I wouldn't ruin a starry night by scribbling things down.

Whenever the stars are seen, I don't feel like writing. They make you feel so small and unimportant... You start thinking about what's happening up there, the amazing and significant events.

I'm feeling nostalgic. I suddenly remembered my sis and my dear village. How are they doing back home? I'm not homesick, but it'd be nice to know that they are doing fine.

Back to real life tomorrow. I'm taking part in all kinds of local entertainment - as a spectator at first. I'm going to Coliseum in the morning. In the meantime...
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484782.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
It's such fun! Pegasus flights, ball throwing, the crowd cheering... The applause, I was explained, is clapping hands, all people at once. I tried that with my hooves. I think it made me deaf in my right ear!

Whatever they say, it's worth trying. I can't wait, my hooves are shaking. All right, I'm up for it. My next stop is Pegasus's back. End of story.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484786.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
I can't quite understand where I am. All turns look the same. Here's a gazebo, and there's another one. I sat down to collect my thoughts while I'm writing another note.

After my spectacular ride, they allowed me to take part in other activities. I'm a local star - or, maybe, a local crazy. Go figure!

This place is... creepy. Not only paths, but thoughts get twisted here. Someone evil created this place. Someone, who enjoys watching helpless wavering. Why on earth did I come here? And these Minotaurs... are staring. Some would say, we're alike, but it's hard to imagine two more different species if you ask me.

I must choose something simpler next time. An obstacle course, for example. The whole trick is to run to the final line and finish first. Unsophisticated, but fun!

Now I should find the way out. In the end, they might remember to find me and get me out of here... I hope.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484792.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

t:
Oh spirits, I don't know what to say! Some places and events just change your very essence over an instant! The Observatory took my breath away.

I learned a lot. They told me about other worlds, about Architects and time travel, about the endless astral. News like this take time to digest.

It will take even longer to see it all!

Whoever is reading this note, I'll say goodbye. I don't know where I'm going, but it's somewhere far away. I'm looking for... I don't know what, but I must find it.

Go your own way. I'm sure it will be legendary. If you want it, of course.

I left a gift for my reader. Find the small crate. It contains the most needful thing.

Take it with you. In a way, I'm grateful. It was a journey that we took together.

Good luck, whoever you are.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r484799.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

My brother went for a journey. I knew that his heart was calling him. I knew this was bound to happen... He doesn't know how to survive outside the camp!

I can't judge him. I don't want him to return only because I'm worried, either. Let him find his own way. I just need to know that he's okay! What if he needs help?

He left this note. All I know is that he went to the Well... Here, you can read it.

t: Thank you! My brother may be young and unreasonable, but I love him dearly.

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 19, 1018

I think I'm onto something. An elf told me about a battle between goblins and the Free Traders' Mercenaries that took place recently. That was rough.

It started the other day when a stranger arrived. Louis told me he was asking about Junes! Someone's been hunting June artifacts. And that someone was spotted asking the mercenaries about any interesting recent findings. Perhaps, he was the one to hire goblins.

Well, anyway, those bastards wanted to break into Asee-Teph. The fight was furious! Rocks falling everywhere, arrows flying around, swords clinking. I wish I could see it!

Unfortunately, this means that those tablet will be very hard to find.

t:
My beloved Nancy!

I'm leaving you this note in case you'll be looking for me. Our holy father Ivan, the Devotee, gave me advice to visit the place known for its holiness. The first Chapel of Tensess! A great miracle happened here. Suddenly, an evil astral demon appeared and smashed the ship! But those who died in astral were brought back to life by the grace of Tensess. They appeared right here!

The chapel is locked and abandoned. It upsets me greatly. I know that Goblins are to blame! They're wicked creatures, thieves and hustlers! I heard an interesting story about them, though. They say that the ship that got wrecked in astral was carrying two goblins. They went into the Purgatory. One of them saw a Servant of Tensess and got scared! He started confessing his sins, promising to sacrifice mirra. The other goblin heard that and offered to sell mirra! And it's been like this ever since: one goblin received Tensess's forgiveness and became a gift collector; the other goblin was cursed and banished from the Purgatory forever.

Well, one way or the other, my beloved Nancy, I should visit the smugglers. Have a row with them. Why have they neglected the Chapel? The mongers have the guts to collect money from pilgrims! Their leader lives somewhere around here. He takes ughing sessions on a meadow, whatever that means. I'll give them an ughing session!

I will see you soon, my darling. I miss you. I'll return to you as soon as I sort this thing out.
There's a roll of parchment that smells like incense.
r487842.n: There's a roll of parchment that smells like incense.

t:
Bloody captain!
Well, we captured a ship of this elvish girl. It carried heaps of cargo! 21 silk cushions!
And the elvish girl was so pretty, leggy and all.
Just when the crew got excited, he tossed her overboard! And the cushions, too.
What a nasty piece of work!
r487862.n: Bloody captain! Well, we captured a ship of this elvish girl. It…

t:
Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 23, 1018

I'm a pirates' captive! This is so exciting!

Found several new tablets in Takalik Harbor. Since I'm imprisoned in this stinky cargo hold anyway, I have time to continue translating tablets from the June language.

"Oh, glorious June Itsmal! Oh, great cities of Uskul and Miktlan! They have fallen to the fury of the June Curse. There's no escape. The curse cannot be lifted. There's nowhere to run. Almost all golems have been shattered. The portal network is destroyed.

We have only one way out left. The Dark promised us salvation. He was the one to warn us about danger. If we'd killed treacherous Sheratan, the last Fire Dragon, the world could split in two, like a giant egg.

Wise Shilonen, Coatl, and Atslan want to seek assistance with him. There are those who oppose. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic, also known as Bane of the Fire Dragons, does not trust the Dark. He suggests we return to the city and use the old portals."

The note stops abruptly. I hope I can steal the key when the goblin brings food.
r487865.n: Marianna Lopatina's Log. June 23, 1018 I'm a pirates' captive! This is…

t:
We arrived at the Pirate Outpost. I say, that's where all the action is!

You can find all kinds of ships here. Some of them I haven't even seen out there, in astral. There were the Lord, and the Breath of Void, and the Striga! Breathtaking! We didn't have much time, though. We had some cargo to sell. Something that we brought from the Dead Sea.

We sealed the deal on July {num2}. This day will be remembered! We haven't made this much, like... ever!
r487866.n: We arrived at the Pirate Outpost. I say, that's where all the action…

t:
Bloody captain!

We got in a dirty game. Here's how it happened. We made it to a port and got ashore. First thing we did was go down to the tavern. There was this fat bearded man in boots. Couldn't put down his newspaper.

So, he spotted our captain, beckoned him with a finger, and offered a good price for that crazy girl jumping about the ruins.

Captain was going to say no, but the money clouded his mind, his eyes lit up! He couldn't turn it down.
r487868.n: Bloody captain! We got in a dirty game. Here's how it happened. We…

t:
Bloody captain!

The June treasure will do us no good, no doubt!

I hear, Junes are cursed people. They brought demons to our world.

Captain shouldn't have gotten involved...
r487871.n: Bloody captain! The June treasure will do us no good, no doubt! I…

t:
There's an unusual place somewhere in the Astral. The place where the Junes once fought two Great Dragons.

Having defeated most of the dragons, the Junes began to chase the remaining dragons around the world. Their sea vessels carrying mighty golems moved incredibly fast with magic. And the Dragon Hunters themselves were equally mighty.

And so the fleet ran down the two strongest dragons, the Great Dragons Tegmin and Rukbat. It was a great battle. The Junes suffered huge losses, but managed to win.

Such creatures have so much magic accumulated in them that their death takes it toll. The last outburst of dragons' magic power froze a whole ocean! The cataclysm that happened later has split the world in two, but the dragon's hearts kept the icy ocean intact. The magic charm has turned the ocean into the two winged monsters' burial vault, wandering in astral.

For centuries, this place was hidden from people's eyes until a pirate expedition came across the snow-covered dragon skeletons. The astral forces were eating away at the ice, exposing the secret lying underneath. Even beyond death the dragons' hearts are bleeding. The blood itself possesses some magical qualities. A Great Mage that drinks it will become immortal.

Although ordinary people have no idea, the icy allod immediately attracted the Treasure Hunters' attention.

The pirates are prepared for anything to get into the icy tomb...
r487875.n: There's an unusual place somewhere in the Astral. The place where the…

t:
I know captain's got a stash!

I noticed him when he approached it. He pushed something, and the stash opened.

I've got to check it out when nobody sees me.

If there's gold, I'll just sneak out quietly and go on the run.

Captain's been holding grudge after that girl wandered away under my supervision, he could throw me overboard.
r487878.n: I know captain's got a stash! I noticed him when he approached it. He…

t:
Oh, these June heritage lovers!

Everybody's needy of this junk like crazy. Everybody wants something new.

We got this order from Simon Suslangerer. He wanted the June crystals, whatever they are. We had to scrounge around for a week, running away from trolls. They don't give a damn what they eat. One of them caught Mum Bad Ear, and the cracking bones was the last we heard. Finally, we delivered the crystals to the Great Mage.

Just as we were going to leave, Antoinette de Delice from Ignis sent a messenger, asking, and I quote, "My dear sailors, bring me some obsidian blades." Which means, we get to dig dirt to collect them. Here are you blades, your Mageness.

We stored some for ourselves, though.  There's still plenty left in the ruins. Especially in hidden stashes.
r487881.n: Oh, these June heritage lovers! Everybody's needy of this junk like…

t:
[Written in irregular block letters.]

Rum. I need rum...

Got to get to the cargo hold. There's a whole barrel.

 Hic... Rum. Captain gives us no rum. He's been saving it.

All we are saying is give people rum!

…

 Gotta put down something else before I forget.

 I've seen a monster. A real monster, I swear.

 That isn't something you'd easily forget. Even rum doesn't help. It was right there, all they way up.

Gotta get some more rum...
r487884.n: [Written in irregular block letters.] Rum. I need rum... Got to get to…

t:
Enough of it, I'm telling you!

Captain gets the profit. We'll lose our lives over nothing.

We shouldn't get involved with that. No searching for damned June artifacts in that dead city!
We must be careful, or else we could end up becoming eternal ghost-like wanderers of the astral seas, without being able to taste food or feel the breeze!

Let's start a riot! Throw captain over board along with the June trinkets!
r487887.n: Enough of it, I'm telling you! Captain gets the profit. We'll lose our…

t:
Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 18, 1018

I'm so angry! It took me a while to catch this idiot! Thank Tensess, I've got the tablets now. And this is the missing part!

I restored the missing fragment. It's a story of the great fall of the city June Itsmal.

"For the city was great and the citizens were proud. Gifts were brought to June Itsmal from all over the world.   Beautiful ships arrived at Takalik harbor. June Itsmal ruler, the great Xolocipilli, was brave and wise. He used to kill the fire dragons.

Everything changed in one day. The Curse came to the city. The walls were tall, the gates were strong, but all defenses fell. The Curse took lives with just one stare. Mighty golems taller than the tallest trees have come to battle. But even they couldn't stop the Curse. The towers fell. Xolocipilli's palace fell and buried the city ruler underneath. Only a few survivors escaped the ruins of June Itsmal in the dead of night.

What happened next? Whoever wrote this, they clearly survived! I need to find the next piece...

I asked around if anything interesting was found lately. People tell me that they saw one girl of easy virtue bragging about a pretty stone with strange inscriptions.  Not much of a trace, but that's all I have.

Boy, it never gets old.
Take it. I know you can find Ath-Zak, wherever he is! I'll be waiting for us to meet, just like I waited back then...

Be very careful. Nihaz is treacherous. He never lies to you directly, but you shouldn't trust him. The Dark God enjoys playing with us, beckoning us with false hope.

You risked so much for us. I'm eternally grateful.
Remember! You'll only have one chance when it comes to the results.
r488156.n: What do you think about Nihaz and his game?

t:
Tka-Rik was one of the magicians in an old book from my childhood. This mage is sleeping on a remote island, and when he wakes up, the good old times will return.

We're remote descendants of those who escaped from June cities, when the Curse came. Now I know that Tka-Rik and I went our separate ways then. He opened up a portal that carried my people far away from these lands.

Life became a legend. The legend became a fairy tale.
r488157.n: What do you know about Tka-Rik?

t:
Bits and pieces.

Zak saved me on Ignos... and then Zak turned out to be my beloved Ath-Zak. They defeated the Curse together with the wise Tka-Rik. I don't know what happened next. I only remember the darkness... and voices. A lot of voices. Moaning, crying, whispering...

Stop! If you take one more step, I'll summon the Catacomb Masters! You'll die an awful death!

…

No, wait... it was... so long ago.

Oh, my beloved Ath-Zak! What happened to us?
Who are you? Where's my beloved Ath-Zak?
r488160.n: Who are you? Where's my beloved Ath-Zak?

t:
Marianna Lopatina's Log.

July 1, 1018

I found a pilgrim, who is also a Demon Hunter among other things!

And I say, he's got a keen eye! He knows his way around demons, like he has a nose for them.

The Hunter told me that he found ruins with traces of a demon so powerful that even Octulhu would be like a kitten to a tiger. He said that the battle of this demon and a mage had bent the earth. Over time, water accumulated there.

I wonder if I can find this place. My search might be coming to an end!
You see a carefully folded log page.
r488166.n: You see a carefully folded log page.

r488172.n: [Make a drawing of a tablet in the sand]

t: Not gonna tell you. Bring me the squirrel. Then you can have the tablet.
r488173.n: Why do you need a squirrel?

t: Give? No way! I trade. Find me a squirrel, and you can have your... Tab...let.
r488174.n: I need it badly. Will you give it to me?

t: Oh, I get it! I took your tablet. To play.
r488175.n: It's a slab with a surface that bears an inscription.

r488177.n: It's square in shape and it's got letters.

r488178.n: Um... Hello! You look peaceful, unlike your kin. Do you know anyone who's recently found…

t: Give the squirrel, take the tablet. Living is better than dead.

r488182.n: In fact, you don't need a squirrel. All you need is friendship and attention, but your…

t: Take it and leave. And never come back.
r488184.n: Here's the squirrel's dead body. Goof off with me again, and you will share its fate.

t: All kinds of loafers hang around here...
r488185.n: All kinds of loafers hang around here...

t: [The squirrel stares at you, you stare back]
r488191.n: [The squirrel stares at you, you stare back]

t: Aye, I've seen him. He's been around asking what's up. He should be auditing the most distant warehouse.
He's somewhere around. You could find him yourself.

Here's what I found. There are other hidden mechanisms in June ruins. One of them is surely located in the ruins. No idea which ones, but they're the only ruins on Asee-Teph that aren't in the middle of greenery. The tablet also said that "our buildings will never turn to dust", and a stone that allows to see hidden paths... This might be a hint. I could go there myself, but I have work to do. Would you mention my name when you speak with Historians? I could escape, you know! I'll put that down for you, just in case.

Oh, right. Sorry, I got carried away. My ignorant colleagues, pardon me saying, took the tablets away together with garbage. You'll hardly find them. They must have ended up in a museum. I didn't just give them away! When I first saw the tablets, I knew right away that they were a big deal. I spent nights deciphering them! I'm not a scientist like you, but I managed to sort them out.
r488290.n: Will you finally tell me where the artifact is?

t: But, you see, I'm stuck here! All because of the family pressure. "Get a real job", they said. My friends never took it seriously, either. I even attended a training...

Oh, the Historians sent you? I greatly respect your society. I've always wanted to do what they do! Oh, the romance, excavations, and ancient mysteries! I'm crazy about them! My cousin is a Historian... was...
r488292.n: It's quite a task to find you! I'm doing some research for... you know, Historians. I…

t: Yeah, quite recently! He was auditing the warehouse, and then he went to the Headquarters to do some paperwork. Well, I don't even know how to read.
I do, every day. He's been around doing some paperwork. You're late, he's just left. He was going to the checkpoint to see how the guys are doing.
r488304.n: I'm looking for Quartermaster. Have you seen him?

t: There he is. Can't you see him?

r488321.n: Who is the worthiest of our protection?

t: Go up the ritual plate. Fall asleep on it and gain the knowledge that failed to save us, but it might save you.
Correct! The last stele summed it up. Answer: can you go all the way to the end?
Correct! You read a story on the second stele. What danger was concealed in the beginning?
r488330.n: What is worth knowing in the first place?

t: You have seen the ANSWER on the first stone. Do you know what the question is?
Only the one who understands our story is allowed to go further.
r488334.n: Only the one who understands our story is allowed to go further.

t:
"Defeating the great tiger wasn't easy, but the man and the girl were skilled and crafty enough. The Miktlan ruler Witzliwitle stood up and said,

"Say your names!"

"I'm Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic," the man said.

"I'm Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi," the girl said.

And the Miktlan ruler sent the brave girl and the brave man to the Junes' greatest teachers, Shilonen, Coatl, and Atslan. Shilonen once was a sage and a philosopher. Coatl was a great magician. Atslan was a skilled warrior. The three teachers taught them everything they knew. The smart Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic has become the greatest mage, ruling the elements. The strong Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi has become the strongest warrior, so swift and agile that no one could make out her moves.

The Junes' power grew. Ten years after the man and the girl appeared they decided to challenge the dragons."

"The wind howls among the rocks. A fire dragon is flying in the sky. There's fire in her eyes, flame in her jaws. Sharp eyes are watching her every move. The Junes are at the ready. A lot of Dragon Hunters have been trained over these years.

Can anything pierce through the scales that are tougher than stone? Can anything compare to the wings that cover the sky? Is there a fire hotter than the dragon flame?

Only time will tell. War golems roar. Ballistae are sending arrows in the sky, one after another. The dragon is furious. She's on a rampage. She breathes fire. Mages enter the battle. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic is in the vanguard.

This time, it's happening! People outpowered the fire dragons. The dragon cannot believe she is defeated. She hits the ground. Her wounds are bleeding. Hunters rush toward the dragon. Their spears are forged from celestial iron, they glitter in the sun.

What to expect from this fight? The monster is dangerous even after it lands. Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi is there first. She dodges the gigantic paws and tail that flip and hit the people. The dragon is furious. Rivers of flame burn down dozens of hunters.

The battle rages on... The fire dragon is agonizing. Mages hit her with lightning bolts, golems shower her with stones, and the first among Hunters finally drives her spear into a flaming eye. And the dragon's final blast hits her.

Is there need to mention what happens next? The Junes are happy. Dead body of their eternal enemy lies in front of them. The Junes are grieving. Many lives ended on this day. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic is on his knees... he has lost his love."
The stele is covered in June words.
r488340.n: The stele is covered in June words.

t:
"You've taken my heart. I'll take yours," Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic says as he draws an obsidian blade.

The bleeding dragon's heart is delivered to the Main Temple. Dragon blood is running like an endless stream. Greatest heroes of the Junes pass a goblet full of dragon blood. They drink without knowing that blood endows them with strength, longevity, and eternal thirst for dragon blood...

What happened that night? The Junes go out to the terrace to see a creature of an amazing beauty, shining like the sun of God... One after another, they kneel before him.

"I am your Creator. My name is Sarn," his voice thunders. "My children, you have done an extraordinary thing! The enemy put me in chains. Today you broke one of the chains. You are the chosen ones. You're the embodiment of my intention. You have my blessing. Your goal is to destroy all the dragons, find each of the cursed monsters, and exterminate their kin without pity. You can do it! And them... I will be free."

Inspired by the Creator's blessing, the Junes swore loyalty to him. Now the dragons will taste their fury! Incinerated cities and dead people will be avenged! Junes will forever chase the dragons - to the edge of the world!
r488343.n: "You've taken my heart. I'll take yours," Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic…

t: A series of blurry images brings you a gibberling's cunning face. You immediately realize that this is the one you've been looking for! You can't see his partners in the fog, but there's one phrase you can make out, "Termites? That's nothing! Anyone could beat them! They're just tiny insects." You're keeping this memory for a long time.

Everything around is blurry and sparkly. You can see consequences of a terrible war that happened in this land. Traces of battles, dead bodies... no living thing dares to approach the bodies. There are no vultures or scavengers here. The "non-life" seems to be caused by an unknown disease that killed everything.

Suddenly you see a girl with light ginger hair and delicate features. She walks between the bodies. Waves of the black disease are rolling away from her.

"You can do it," she says to herself and lifts up her hands to cast a powerful spell on the world. "You are the soul of the world."

Everything is so hazy... You see a different place... but you realize that it's Coba Plateau, only thousands of years ago. You see a skinny man in white robes. Only his amber eyes can be seen under the mask. He leans over a June stele to read the text on it. He's silent and thoughtful.

He hears a hail, "Tep!" He looks around.
The reminiscence stops. You feel like you could emerge in it.
What do you want from me?
r488452.n: What do you want from me?

t:
Just wait.

That clown liked to confuse things. I'm sure the names were one big headache. He studied the June language and was very proud about it. He wanted June to become an international universal language.

What nonsense! Scientific logic must be the universal language, not some ancient blabbering.

Why don't you help me out? Sort out his notes and bring me the clear information about the Hive's hierarchy. There should be six types, described in five notes.

You can go now.

You see, I've been here for a few weeks, and I can't leave this place. My negligent assistant went to collect information about the previous Hive hierarchy, and disappeared. The termites must have eaten him by now. They probably scattered his notes around.
r488471.n: What do I need to do?

t: No, something's wrong. This doesn't correspond with my studies. Go and try harder.

You could do.

Listen closely. I can't help you, but there was this crazy colleague of mine. She was and Elf, loved to talk, and hated systematic labor. She studied local fauna that shows mild signs of intelligence.

If anyone saw your friend, that would be her. I have no idea where she is now, but she left a note, Nih knows why!

I haven't read it, but you might find it useful.
And finally, who was the last?
Go it. Who was the second-to-last?
I put that down. Who was next?
She came and she went. You've come, and you're leaving, I guess. I'll leave too. I will do the research. Just need to learn how to write to leave notes, too.
r488533.n: What are you planning to do now?

t: It's been stolen! Those crafty and nimble, who got themselves a ship... We don't approach them. It's all death, and nothing else.

They gave her to me. I was going to make a stew, but she didn't get scared. Just kept telling me stories. I was caught up in them. I was hiding her for a few days, and you know what? I think, we made friends! She had to leave. There was research to do. I didn't go with her, although she invited. She even managed to teach me how to read - very slowly, and even left me a book. She said I should read a book if I wanted to find her.

Let me tell you. I might understand it all along the way myself. Just don't hit me.

So, I was living my happy life here. We're no sophisticated people. If we catch fish, we eat fish. If we trap a rhino, we eat the rhino. A tiger? Cool! You're the tastiest, though.

Hunting has been dangerous lately. As it went some time ago, you just had to wait by the fence and grab the first one that emerged from there. And then make barbecue or a stew.

Then the Tavern owner returned. Ooh, he's scary! You may not notice. We, ogres, have the guts for such things. Terrifying. Walking up there has become weird, as if eyes were staring at you from the sky.

Now it's hungry times. And there's this girl. She came herself! She looked so delicious, our mouths watered. And she went on and on about something.
Huh? I don't know... I'm not sure...
r488537.n: You... Aren't you going to try and eat me?

t: You're very tired, and yet you have many trials ahead. Enough reading for today.

You're tired of reading, but you turn the page. It's "Thibault de Desirae's thoughts on some paradoxes on Coba Plateau". Here's a fragment.

The story that happened here, on Coba Plateau, keeps haunting me. When Tep was constructing the pyramids, preparing to destroy his people, this place was the center of his cult.

Contrary to popular belief, the greatest battle between him and the Zem Mechanics took place here, in a place now known as Spectral Gorge. That's where the pyramid with a destroyed top is.

My expedition conducted research and established some facts, contradicting the popular interpretation of the story.

First of all, there's the question, who buried Nefer Ur and other mechanics on Hickut (now known as Xadagan allod), although they died here, on Coba Plateau.

Besides, we failed to discover residual plague in soil and water, although given the power of infection, this place must still be dead.

Here is an interesting fact learned by my colleague Noel de Blizare from legends of local people, now living in the Holy Lands.

According to them, death came here. It breathed its black breath, and life itself agonized. Just when there seemed to be no hope, a beautiful girl, a great sorceress, came here. Morning glory flowers grew in her footsteps as she walked. With her power she destroyed death and left no trace. It took her a while to bury all the dead people. She sealed the eternally dying Tep in his main Pyramid known as Asee-Teph.

Who could that be? A Great Mage from the past? An unknown goddess? I'm afraid, we'll never know the answers. Maybe, Zayan knows something?

You're reading another page from the folder. "Sarang Petosiris, Tep Cultist's speech". Here's a fragment.

Tep? How dare you call this name?

Tep is the greatest necromancer ever! In my past life, I was honored to help him! Tep was studying June magic then.
Junes... oh yes, they achieved so much. So, Tep studied them. His primary field was magic of blood. June knew a thing or two about it. Blood conceals great power. It has the life power of the Spark. By consuming blood, you consume someone else's power. Why do you think the Great Mages drink dragon blood? Or the demonologists drink demon blood? Or vampires!

Tep went even further. June magic didn't help them when the Curse appeared... the first demon.

Yes, that's right. The legendary June Curse was a demon. Didn't you know it? That's weird. I've seen it as clearly as I see you. And you might see it some day! Why? What do you mean - why? It's there somewhere. What did it look like? The last time I saw it, it was following the real Junes. They're extinct now, of course. But there are so many people with June blood in their veins! Why do you think the astral demons look so much like the Curse? It's out there! I can't believe you live in this world and know so little about it.

Tep now consumed Sparks instead of blood. A straightforward way is always faster. But he needed a stock. A stock of Sparks. It wouldn't work our if Tep hadn't found a record about the Box. Nih's box, of course.

Basically, this world is a trap for Sparks. Nothing can leave it. Tep found the source of power that's holding it inside without letting anything out. How? I don't know.

Based on this power, he built pyramids. He also created the Plague. You'll have a taste of it when Tep comes back...

Ouch, don't hit me!

The note stops abruptly.

You're reading another page from the folder. "Joint report of Nomarkhs Semerkhet, Yasskul Khufukhaf, and Taltal: the Holy Lands research." Here's a fragment:

The conclusions based on the results of our research are fully consistent with our preliminary assessment, stated during the historical conference, "The June impact on Zem culture."

The following has been proven:

1. A significant cultural impact took place, expressed in the urge for a ritual, where every Zem must visit the former June state and examine the ruins to develop motivation to search for immortality. This fact is confirmed both by the testimonies of witnesses (including the authors of the report) and by the numerous traces of Zem presence on Asee-Teph.

2. Proven fact: a journey of a famous Zem known as Tep that place around 2470 AD (Old Era).

3. The study of the "Tensess Temple" object has provided evidence that the journey has made a deep impact on the individual's personality and mind.

4. It has been established that soon after the journey Tep discovered the nature of Sparks and began a large-scale construction of Spark storage facilities, also known as "Tep's Pyramids".

Conclusions:

With a high degree of probability, we conclude that Tep's journey to the ruins of the June civilization invested in his scientific breakthrough and discovery of the nature of Sparks and Immortality. Speculations on the nature of knowledge (in particular, the marginal theory that the god of Death appeared before Tep and personally gave him the knowledge) is left to the readers.

You're reading another page from the folder. "A letter from Yaver Amenia, Evette de Doucer, and Antoinette de Grandeur to the Council of Historians on allod Neigh." Here's a fragment:

Dear colleagues, we have completed the study of the June ruins on Eljune. In the course of our research, we reconstructed the history of this location.

June Itsmal was one of the largest June cities. Located in the bay, it had an exit to the open sea and the ocean surrounding Yule. This made it a major trade port. The city comprised not only the immediate area of today's June Itsmal, but the neighboring quarters, located on a vast area from the Jakala Ruins to the Icemirror Lake.

Goods from all over the world were brought to the city. The evidence was found that trade was conducted with Tekyan people from Irdrich and with a mysterious "fifth tribe of people".

The city sustained serious damage during the dragon war. On numerous occasions it was burned almost to the ground, but recovered every time.
The fatal blow was made when the June Curse appeared here. Research proves that it is the original form of astral demons, enhanced with extraordinary power.

Most citizens died; the rest were able to escape through open portals. The final wave of survivors avoided death at the last moment by miracle. We may safely state that the Junes have chosen a tactic of scatter, splitting into small groups and spreading across the continent. This allowed them to avoid the Curse for a long time. However, this also led to a gradual cultural regression and assimilation with other people.

Wormfaces later visited the ruins. Obviously, they became sacred locations for former Junes, who kept memory of the past.

You're reading another page from the folder. It's called, "Noel de Blizare's Journal". Here's a fragment.

I never regretted going on this expedition!

It has everything my teacher advised me, Alphonse De Ardeur, the great natural scientist.

The Holy Lands are full of various life forms. I talked to almost all of them! It makes you think: what could one discuss with a troll? How to find an approach to a Mantis? What could Harpies tell you?

And I'm saying, there's a way to everyone's heart. I, for instance, talked to ogres. They are considered rude and cruel, and unjustly so! There's beauty in everyone. It may be too deep, but it's important to find the right words.

I managed. It turns out, the poor primitive minds are susceptible to speech. It you talk, and talk, and talk, they respond. But not everyone is capable of it. I'm remembering poor Adele de Grandeur... She had a brilliant mind and several PhDs, but she choked up and skipped a beat... and became ogre's meal.

What's also important, these people are keeping their history. They write songs and poems, carve pictures on bones. I learned a lot. The ancient legends from the June times, stories about wars of the past...

Junes were belligerent. With the education they received from our Elven ancestors, they became a truly fearsome power. They built routes that allowed them to navigate through the portal network. We've begun to figure them out just recently! Not to mention golems, both small and big as mountain!

Lamias, for example, remember the June wars very well. Alphonse was right about them. Lamias worshipped a snake goddess. Junes found her and fought to kill. Fancy that, they killed a real deity, albeit minor. No wonder the dragons wasn't a problem for them.

I'm sending my notes to Bertille de Pluie. She's so smart, she could compile a great book from them!

Bertille's handwritten note: "Someone must explain this fool that personal contact is something completely different from her own definition."

You're reading a page from the folder. It's called, "Marianna Lopatina's Log, August 13, 1018"

This is the last page of my log. All other pages are stolen by goblins. There's something wrong in the Holy Lands. Now I'm thinking about coincidences. The Ath-Zak legend is called "Cursed Lands".

Are the Holy and the Cursed Lands all that different? When the world wasn't split apart, it took only a few day's travel to get from Gipat to Eljune.

Now it's time to sum up my travel. Junes' fate is clear. They fell under the Curse that has been hunting for the Junes. They separated. Some of them became Wormfaces, others managed to escape.

The outcasts are now condemned to misery. I spoke with a Tep Cultist. He was kind enough to share some information, even under the threat of being disassembled into gears.

Tep took great interest in June heritage. He and his servants met the Junes who escaped from the Curse. There was hearsay about a city in the mountains under a spell so powerful that it drove the Curse away.

This city was where Gipat is now. Was it Tka-Rik's farewell gift? We can only guess the future. Hundreds of years later, the Aro tribes arrived at these lands. They assimilated with the June descendants and created a mixture that rewarded the world with creators of a rare talent.

My readers probably have already guessed. Today it is known as the Dead City. Nothing lasts forever. The Curse was destined to find June descendants early or late. Some of them escaped again. More Kanians than Junes, they now live in the Settlement.

Zak found his distant relatives in the Settlement. Is this the destiny mocking us? It's up to you to judge.

I'm going on a new expedition. I want to find out if Jigran is a legend or reality.

The book isn't the one you're looking for, but it's interesting. It's called "Bertilia's Final Report about the Holy Land Events: Historical Evidence". It's come a long way. Bertilia has collected the most interesting extracts from research papers.

There's an instruction written in red on the cover.

"Urgent. To Zayan."
r488547.n: The book isn't the one you're looking for, but it's interesting. It's…

t: No way. That one was a daredevil. You don't stand a chance. I'm not taking this responsibility.

Ah, the brave and adventurous one? I knew he had many friends! He wanted to solve the Quicksand riddle, and I helped him. Gave him an ancient Zem artifact. I always carry one or two with me! I have no idea in which backpack, though...
r488594.n: I talked to your... ...colleague near the hive. He says you know where to find a…

t: I'm always happy to help, but why?
r488595.n: Hello! I was looking for you.

t: Wonderful! I have a plan, and now I have someone to carry it out. Listen up. I made a goblin mask. It isn't perfect, but they aren't geniuses, either. Wear it, get inside, and find my boss. Listen carefully to goblin talk. They'll give you an idea where they keep him. Or where they used to keep him.
r488702.n: I need to find him, too, so why not?

t: Oh, that. Alright. You must be looking for Key, but I don't know how to put it... He's been missing. He went to this camp, it's been a few nights that he's gone. I can't leave. I promised I'd wait for him, and I'm a coward... Will you help us?
r488703.n: I have no idea, all I have is this letter.

The volume opens on the page you need:

"Sensors must be attached to the 13 parts of the capsule as pictured, then a test launch should be carried out.

In the first half minute, it is necessary to carefully monitor the readings of the sensors and make necessary adjustments to the operation of the device (reduce power at high values and lower it at low values).

It was experimentally established that, if there is no emergency shutdown of the systems in half a minute, then the device is successfully calibrated."

Hmm. I don't usually take prisoners, but one of these scoundrels might be useful. If worst comes to worst, we'll have someone to execute!

t:
You open the last pages and read:

"The apple worked splendidly! Old methods always work unlike this modern magic...

I put a spell on the girl - she thinks she brings pies to her grandmother, but she actually brings me blood for my enchantments. Everyone in their city trusts each other, no one would suspect a thing...

She just needs to keep her mouth shut and not get too frail, or else they might notice..."
r491752.n: You open the last pages and read: "The apple worked splendidly! Old…

t: That's commendable, but everyone already knows you're here. Go in and do something useful.
I record everything and everyone that enters Amarantha. In our situation, order is one of the few things we can rely on. Unfortunately, not everyone shares that view.
I think he... left to observe other worlds...
The only thing they can't take away - watching the world, enjoying ourselves and appreciating the nature around us... Come sit with us, relax for a minute!
My thoughts go round and round. I wonder where we are going. And whether we are really going anywhere, and so on, and so forth, and then I think about the meaning of all this... Is this even real...?

You see who I am. Who I was a minute ago is in the past, and who I will become in the future is unknown. I'll just say I sought many things in my life, but here amidst all worries and troubles, in the city of outcasts, I found peace.
What do you want to know?
r491898.n: What do you want to know?

t: I observe, meditate. I like watching her work. She's so... blunt and determined. So different from other elves...

My story is a long one! Are you willing to listen?

Everything started ten years ago in the tower of a Great Mage. I went there on a mission from my Patriarch. I needed to summon a Shadow that would strike the very Spark of Clement de Desirae. Their family took away our allod, and we became exiles!

Some Kanian nobles and rebels who served the White Knight were a part of this. The Knight joined Tep at the time, and my Patriarch also had ties to Tep.

I accomplished my mission... But I was unlucky to run into a young hero, a vagabond... who looked a bit like you... but maybe not. He interfered... I tried to escape through the portal, but something went wrong. I was thrown somewhere else... And I lost track of my brother Arsen who was with me...

I wandered through allods for years, doing deeds that would be glorified in songs. I visited the snowy Lightwood! Saw exploding hares on Jigran! Sank into the quicksands of Suslanger! Climbed the Great Trea on Yakhch! Hid in the foggy valley on Forox! Fought off bandits in the lair of the Gray Prince!

Finally, I was reunited with my family! Even though I had to become a vampire... I only regret that my brother is not with me.

We came to this allod when de Desirae took our home. They accused us of so many things. Louis de Desirae used it as an excuse to get his paws on our Nocturne.

All great houses have their House: de Ardeur have Lumenara, de Blizare, Vevre, Grandeur, Delice, and Pluie have Gelida, Florenta, Stellara, Ignista and Tempesta. De Desirae have a small Tenebra... It's no wonder they were jealous.

And now we are doomed to endure this wretched existence in a remote corner of Umoir!

I went here a second time after that setback on Avilon... and our defeat in the Demons' City. So they're saying Sarn is gone? We are lucky to outlive so many... Perhaps I'll be able to go back home someday.
r491904.n: It's strange to find myself here...

An ominous book in a dark leather binding. The cover depicts some horrors: screaming people, scary grimacing corpses. The grimoire is locked, but when you hold it up to your ear, you hear ominous whispers coming from its pages. Perhaps it should stay locked.

t:
Sometimes it's good to take a break from work...

So who do we have to thank for this celebration? You, ! You are the Hero of Sarnaut. You started this chain of events 10 years ago.

Let us remember how much we've lost over the years. Those who gave their lives to bring this day closer. Does anyone remember the allods Arav, Ark, Jalin, Imbul, or Karakir?

If we don't preserve what we have left – our descendants will not forgive us!

t:
I'm glad to see you here, ! Let no one say the Empire cares about nothing but wars. If there's a potential for peace, we do our best to realize it.

We have enough problems without having to fight the League. Together, we can accomplish so much more. That is why we initiated a cultural exchange program - this is our chance to show everyone a more progressive life. When they see the beauty of Xadaganian cities, they will understand that our path is the right one. That's the Great Nezeb's will.

Allow me to congratulate you on behalf of the Conclave of the Empire, even though my colleagues, Great Mages, are absent from this event.

So, on behalf of the Great Mage Simon from Suslanger, Great Mage Felix from Yakhch, Great Mage Leonid from New Igsh, Great Mage Abram from Vechnoslavsk, Great Mage Rustam from Istinsk, Great Mage Mansur from Manodar, Great Mage Negus Nevzr from Izune, and from all other Great Mages of small allods of the Empire - happy anniversary, !

t:
I often wonder how the world has changed since your journey began, . Yes, a lot of things have already been discovered, and mana power engineering has been rapidly developing. Perhaps, thanks to you, we gained a variety of new goods.

The City Council is still counting the trophies we got after defeating Gorluxor; the technologies created by Tep for the world of illusions are still being studied at ZIT Headquarters.

And now we are ready to go to another world. Again, with the help of technologies we obtained thanks to you. The world is changing, and these changes are inevitable. Even the drowsy League is forced to move forward now. Its representatives such as Catherina are often more imperial in spirit than many of the conservative bureaucrats from Yasker’s Tower.

What will you find outside Sarnaut? I'm confident that, whatever it is, it will change our world once again.
r495801.n: I often wonder how the world has changed since your journey began, .…

t:
Ah, it's you...

Are you expecting words of encouragement or something? There'll be none. We are all prisoners of Hirkalla who now rules Sarnaut from her throne in Jigran. She is called the Darkest Mistress, so go ask her for parting wishes...
r495803.n: Ah, it's you... Are you expecting words of encouragement or something?…

t:
Greetings, hero!

Well, I'm not disappointed this time... Yes, some things could have been avoided, and you should have been more careful and not trusted strangers with important state secrets... But what got we wanted: Hirkalla was weakened. As for Tep... He was beaten the first time, so he'll be beaten a second time. That's what I think.

This time by the forces of the Great Mages. They didn't gather here for nothing - the hunt for Tep is underway, and we're ready to strike. After all, over the past years we've learned a lot, discovered things that you have no idea about, so we might surprise the old necromancer yet!

But you go on, enjoy yourself! Set off fireworks, set fire to Catherina's skirt, drink with the crocodile! Have fun.
